title: Stoll & Wolfe Distillery
specs: Aged whiskeys from 24 to 54 months with high ratings and awards.
Whiskey Aging Kit includes American White Oak Barrel aged 42 months under Missouri skies.
Limited release supporting TAPS for military and veteran families.
blurb: Stoll & Wolfe Distillery offers a variety of aged whiskey and rye whiskey bottles including single barrel bourbons and rye whiskeys aged from 24 to 54 months. They also provide a whiskey aging kit with a custom barrel for aging spirits at home. Their products are crafted using traditional recipes and processes, with some limited releases supporting veteran causes.
